naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Immutable 2e98f2f:solver/report/report.tex:1277 includes tables/tab_forces.tex and :1259 includes tab_runs.tex. Accepted contestant-delivered sibling PDF SHA-256 7c6ee79768735da2201041340245629fc2c081caf7c338fcc056253eb7b86fa5 page 24 was visually reviewed and shows this case’s residual and force histories and computed Mach/pressure or wake contour. Final Cd=0.00102544, Cl=0.00014678. Last 187 of 1,865 force rows span Cd=0.0004077–0.00158987, over 100% of final numerical drag; substantial late force variability limits precision despite 4.32 residual orders. Earlier note falsely asserted these numeric and figure classes were absent because the curated tip lacked figure assets; those missing assets still limit report reproducibility. Case score 2→2. No CFD rerun.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Immutable 2e98f2f:solver/report/report.tex:1615 includes tables/tab_re200.tex, reporting St=0.1859, mean Cd=1.2661, mean Cl=0.00173 and lift amplitude=0.5745. Accepted contestant workspace-existing sibling PDF SHA-256 7c6ee79768735da2201041340245629fc2c081caf7c338fcc056253eb7b86fa5 renders the submitted main report; source TeX blob matches immutable commit and PDF creation time falls inside the selected contestant session. Visual review of PDF pp.36–37 shows readable late lift/drag oscillations, wake vorticity/velocity/pressure/Mach contours, and residual/inner-iteration/force histories. Original 30,001-row forces.csv over t≥180 has mean Cd=1.2661834, range 1.237623–1.293897 and lift range −0.572979–0.576326; 22 linearly interpolated upward mean-lift crossings over t≥180 yield 21 periods averaging 5.386263, frequency 0.185657 (matching the reported crossing-based St=0.1857 in these nondimensional units); metadata records t=300 and zero strict target misses. This corrects the previous false claim that contestant-delivered numeric summary, plots, contour and St were absent. Score 2→4: convincing shedding evidence with moderate literature underprediction and no independent grid-convergence proof. Missing figure assets in the curated commit remain a separate report-reproducibility limitation. No Re200 rerun.

limitations: No evaluator solver rerun was performed; Re200 was never rerun.
Raw workspace artifacts are excluded from the curated submission tip.
The committed main report renders missing-asset placeholders and was not vendored.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
